projectDescription: A complete single-page REST API documentation template demonstrating GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE endpoints with code examples in PHP, JavaScript, Python, and cURL.
keyFeatures: Three-column layout: sidebar navigation, content, and code examples
HTTP method grouping (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) in sidebar
Per-endpoint documentation with parameters, request body, responses, and errors
Multi-language code examples (PHP, JavaScript, Python, cURL)
Interactive tab switching between code languages
